Navigation.entryDescription: Build, generate, and manage fight camps in one place.

PublicHome.lead: Personalised fight camps that adapt to your readiness, recovery and injuries.
PublicHome.summary: Know what to train today, and adjust before fatigue becomes failure.
PublicHome.betaNote: Private beta · About 2 minutes to set up
PublicHome.row1Body: Fight date, schedule, style, goals, and restrictions.
PublicHome.row2Body: Load, recovery, nutrition, and injury limits.
PublicHome.row4Body: The next session, adapted to how you checked in.
PublicHome.proof1Body: See the work that fits your fight date, schedule, and current condition.
PublicHome.proof2Body: Readiness and injury check-ins adjust the session when needed.
PublicHome.proof3Body: Changes to today's work stay connected to the full camp.
PublicHome.step1Body: Add your fight date, weekly schedule, training history, and restrictions.
PublicHome.step2Body: Report your recovery, fatigue, soreness, and active injuries.
PublicHome.step3Body: Get phases, weekly targets, and sessions built around your fight date.
PublicHome.step4Body: Unlxck modifies today's work while keeping the wider camp aligned.

Auth.joinBeta: New to UNLXCK? Join the beta
Auth.loginTitle: Pick up where you left off.
Auth.signupSummary: Set up once, then get a fight camp that tells you what to train and adapts as you go.
Auth.benefit1: Know what to train today, built around your fight date.
Auth.benefit2: Adjust before fatigue becomes failure with daily check-ins.
Auth.benefit3: Your whole camp stays in one place, so you never start over.
Auth.noPayment: No payment required during the private beta.
Auth.roleIntro: Unlxck is one app for everyone in the camp. Pick how you want to use it. Athlete access is open now — coach and gym accounts arrive in public beta.
Auth.athleteDescription: Run Advanced Intake and generate a saved fight camp on your athlete workspace.
Auth.coachDescription: Manage rosters and build camps for the fighters you coach.
Auth.coachSoon: Coach accounts will be available in public beta.
Auth.gymDescription: Run your gym, oversee coaches, and manage athletes in one place.
Auth.gymSoon: Gym accounts will be available in public beta.
Auth.wholeCampTitle: One app for the whole camp.
Auth.wholeCampSummary: Start as an athlete today. Coach and gym tools are on the way, all inside the same Unlxck workspace — no separate apps to manage.
